$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.reason: User asked for a set of accommodation-advert fields to live in apollo-core: a HOSTEL checkbox, a hostel URL that replaces the chat CTA, min nights, max days, and an availability window for non-hostel stays.
$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.fix: Added an ACCOMMODATION BLOCK to MetaRegistry's `classified` post-meta map (src/Core/MetaRegistry.php), directly after _classified_featured: _classified_hostel (boolean), _classified_hostel_url (string, esc_url_raw), _classified_min_nights (integer), _classified_max_days (integer), _classified_avail_start / _classified_avail_end (string, Y-m-d). All single + show_in_rest.
$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.why_classified_not_new_cpt: Accommodation adverts are not a separate CPT -- they are `classified` posts discriminated by _classified_type in ('accommodation','rent_space'). Keeping the block on the classified map avoids inventing a parallel post type for what is a variant of one.
$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.privacy_semantics: _classified_hostel is the privacy switch for the whole accommodation surface, not just a label. A hostel is a registered, worldwide-listed business, so its listing is shown openly (no padlock) and its CTA links out to the hostel's own site. Every other accommodation is a private home and stays auth-gated, identical to resale tickets. Absent meta reads as false, so the default is always locked -- the safe direction for a privacy gate.
$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.availability_window_scope: _classified_avail_start/_end are non-hostel only, per the user's spec (hostels operate year-round). The adverts metabox hides and clears them when the hostel box is ticked; min-nights/max-days apply to both.
$accommodation_meta_block_2026_07_28.consumers: apollo-adverts mirrors the block in includes/constants.php (APOLLO_ADVERTS_META_KEYS) so it flows through apollo_adverts_register_meta()'s apollo_core_register_meta filter, and exposes helpers apollo_adverts_is_hostel() / is_accommodation() / is_identity_locked() / hostel_url() in includes/cpt.php.

$classified_meta_map_completed_2026_07_2.reason: Audit of the resale-ticket and accommodation advert pipelines found apollo-core's `classified` post-meta map was an incomplete mirror of what apollo-adverts actually declares.
$classified_meta_map_completed_2026_07_2.finding: 7 of 24 keys were missing from MetaRegistry's classified map: _classified_type, _classified_views, _classified_rating, _classified_badge, _classified_event_title, _classified_event_date, _classified_event_loc. $classified_meta_map_completed_2026_07_2.fix: Added those 7 plus the two new relation keys (_classified_event_id, _classified_quantity) as a documented TICKET RESALE BLOCK and a kind/system group, alongside the ACCOMMODATION BLOCK added earlier the same day. _classified_type carries the full enum including the legacy ticket_sell/rent_space aliases, with a comment stating that values are canonicalised to general|ticket|accommodation by apollo_adverts_canonical_type() before any write. Parity between core's map and apollo-adverts' constants asserted programmatically: 24 keys each, 0 divergent in either direction.

$card_contract_2026_08_17.what: The sibling of the Surface Contract. A SURFACE is the full single page opened in place; a CARD is the repeated small representation of one item inside a list, grid, rail or embed. apollo_card_register() / apollo_card_get() / apollo_card_render() / apollo_card_render_many() / apollo_card_styles_once().

Completely different DOM, no shared partial, no shared class contract.

$card_contract_2026_08_17.why_a_registry_and_not_a_shortcode: Shortcodes and get_template_part() conventions both already existed in this ecosystem and neither prevented four divergent copies, because neither gives a card a SINGLE OWNER or a STYLE LEDGER. A registry turns 'there is exactly one accommodation card' from a habit into a checkable fact.
$card_contract_2026_08_17.the_style_ledger_is_the_point: apollo_card_render() emits the card's stylesheet the first time that card type is rendered in a request and never again (static $printed, same mechanism as apollo_event_lightbox_state()). This is what makes 'the CSS is not loaded on this screen' structurally impossible — the consumer never had to know the card had styles, so it cannot forget to enqueue them.
safety_properties: DORMANT-SAFE — apollo_card_get() returns null unless the renderer is callable right now, so a screen can be written against a card before that card exists and lights up when the callable appears. Mirrors apollo_surface_get().
NEVER CLOBBERS — a second registration for a live type is ignored unless $replace is passed explicitly. Losing silently would reintroduce the exact fight this file ends.
UNKNOWN VARIANT DEGRADES — a typo falls back to the first declared variant rather than rendering '', because an empty string inside a grid reads as 'no results' rather than as a defect.
EMPTY RENDERER EMITS NOTHING — the '' check runs BEFORE the style call, so a declining renderer cannot leak a bare <style> tag into a grid.
REGISTERS NOTHING — no CPT, taxonomy, meta key or table. apollo-core's existing registries remain the only place those happen (02-header.CRITICAL_apollo_core_centralization).
$card_contract_2026_08_17.verification: 13 behaviours simulated and passed in the sandbox (dormant -> lights up, ledger emits once, variant fallback, no-clobber, explicit replace, bad id, unknown type, empty renderer). Brace structure confirmed balanced: 6 function_exists blocks. No PHP binary in this environment, so php -l is unrun.
$card_contract_2026_08_17.guarded_by: apollo-events harness E26 — asserts all five functions exist, the dormant gate, the clobber guard, the print-once ledger, that the file registers no CPT/meta, that apollo-core.php requires it, and that the docblock and APOLLO_CORE_VERSION agree.
$card_contract_2026_08_17.consumers: NONE YET — deliberately. Adoption by the accommodation and track cards is Phase A4/B3 of _inventory/PLAN-outnow-and-hostel.md and is gated on open decisions.

hostel.relation: _classified_hostel_id (integer) on the `classified` CPT. An advert belongs EITHER to a member (post_author) OR to an official hostel — never both.
hostel.admin_only_enforced_at_the_write_boundar: _classified_hostel_id was added to APOLLO_ADVERTS_ADMIN_ONLY_META, which branches the register_meta auth_callback to manage_options. The operator chose a dedicated CPT on the grounds that a hostel is a distinct business entity from a venue. Recorded so the next reader knows it was a decision, not an oversight; _hostel_loc_id is the seam that keeps the two from duplicating meta.

$cpt_registration_ground_truth_audit_202.method: Every register_post_type() and register_taxonomy() call site read from PHP across all 40 plugin folders, constants resolved to literals, hook priorities traced. Registry JSON was read last and NOT trusted.
$cpt_registration_ground_truth_audit_202.headline: apollo-core ALWAYS wins the init:5 race, so EVERY owner-plugin CPT registration for a config-declared slug is unreachable dead code. Core adds its callback inside apollo_core_bootstrap() on plugins_loaded:1; every owner plugin boots at plugins_loaded:15. Same-priority init callbacks run in registration order, so core registers first and every owner's post_type_exists() guard returns early.
$cpt_registration_ground_truth_audit_202.the_fallback_philosophy_is_not_implement: CPTRegistry::is_owner_active() (:92) — the function that would make 'fallback only when the owner is inactive' true — is defined and never called anywhere in apollo-core. The only gate is post_type_exists().
$cpt_registration_ground_truth_audit_202.consequence: register_cpt() (:143) takes only labels/public/rewrite/has_archive/menu_icon/supports/rest_base from config and hardcodes the rest. It never passes taxonomies, map_meta_cap, rest_namespace or exclude_from_search. So every owner arg outside that set is silently discarded on a live site.

live_divergences_measured.apollo_sheet: Owner wants show_ui:false, show_in_rest:false, no rest_base ('custom REST controller instead'). Core forces show_ui:true, show_in_menu:true, show_in_rest:true, rest_base 'sheets'. LIVE, apollo_sheet is exposed at /wp-json/wp/v2/sheets with the stock posts controller — the exact opposite of the owner's stated intent. Most consequential mismatch in the set.
live_divergences_measured.track: REGRESSION INTRODUCED TODAY. The owner registration added in $track_and_hostel_cpts_2026_08_17 passes taxonomies:[sound], and that registration never runs. config/taxonomies.php:24 sets $sound_cpts = ['event','dj'] with no 'track', so `sound` is NOT attached to track on a live site — contradicting the rationale written into config/cpts.php and into that registry entry. Fix: add 'track' to $sound_cpts.
live_divergences_measured.classified: Owner supports includes excerpt and comments; config declares four. comments is repaired by a deliberate patch at init:20 (apollo_adverts_add_comment_support). excerpt is NOT repaired and is silently absent.
live_divergences_measured.doc: Owner adds revisions and rest_namespace 'apollo/v1'. Live: no revisions, served at wp/v2/docs.
live_divergences_measured.email_aprio: Same rest_namespace loss — served at wp/v2/email-templates.
live_divergences_measured.all_owners: map_meta_cap:true is never set by core. Capability mapping is uniformly lost.

$cpt_plan_phase0_and_phase2_executed_202.scope: PLAN-cpt-and-admin-panels.md Phase 0 in full, plus Phase 1-3, 1-5 and Phase 2-1..2-4. Phases 1-1/1-2/1-4 and 2-5..2-9 remain GATED on the five open decisions in §6 of that plan.

fatal_fixed.what: The DJ and Local edit screens threw a fatal on every load. Panel.php:323 did $cols = $f['opts']['cols'] unconditionally and then count($cols); _dj_name_lines (DjPanel) and _local_rooms (LocPanel) both declared type=>repeater with opts.fields and no opts.cols, so $cols was null and count(null) is a TypeError on PHP 8 — and the plugin requires 8.1.
fatal_fixed.fixed_twice_over: Both declarations corrected to opts.cols with `name` keys, AND render_repeater()/save_repeater()/render_repeater_card()/save_repeater_card() now default a missing cols/fields to an empty array and return early. A schema defect must degrade to a missing field, never a dead screen.
fatal_fixed.note: save_repeater() had the SAME unguarded access — the fatal existed on save as well as on load, which the original audit did not surface.

silent_defects_fixed._dj_media_kit_stats: repeater_card sub-fields used `key`; render_repeater_card_row() and save_repeater_card() both read `name`. Every input was named `_dj_media_kit_stats[][]` and the saver looked up $data[''] — the field rendered perfectly and NEVER persisted a value.
silent_defects_fixed._dj_booking_status: select opts were wrapped in a 'choices' key; render_field() iterates opts as a flat value => label map, so it emitted one <option value="choices"> with an array as its label.

debug_beacons_removed.count: Ten sites across five plugins — more than the audit's estimate of four.
debug_beacons_removed.client_side: fetch() to http://127.0.0.1:7514 and :7623 in apollo-events (Admin/Metabox.php, apollo-events-create-wire.js, apollo-events-create-form.js), apollo-loc (GalleryMetabox.php) and apollo-templates (frontend-editor.js). These ran in every visitor's or editor's browser and are blocked mixed content on an HTTPS site.
debug_beacons_removed.server_side: file_put_contents() to D:/dev/_livro.rvalle.com.br/… — an absolute path belonging to a DIFFERENT project on one developer's machine — in apollo-lux-panels/Panel.php, apollo-events includes/functions.php (x2, one on apollo_event_get_banner which runs on every event card), EventsController.php, Admin/Metabox.php and UrlImportController.php.
debug_beacons_removed.response_header: apollo-events Plugin.php emitted X-Apollo-Dbg-959e0d on EVERY request, publishing the absolute server path, whether it was writable, and the names of any .shadow-*.bak files. Information disclosure to the open internet. Its init:0 companion did file I/O against ABSPATH on every WordPress boot. Both hooks and both methods removed; debug_959e0d_log() reduced to a no-op because seven inert call sites remain.
debug_beacons_removed.rest_route_REMOVED: apollo/v1/_agent_debug (POST+GET) deleted along with agent_debug_log() and agent_debug_get(). permission_callback was is_user_logged_in(), so ANY subscriber could POST arbitrary JSON that was written to wp_upload_dir()/debug-c3f157.log — the uploads directory is WEB-SERVED — and GET returned the whole 100-entry ring buffer, so one user could read the debug payloads another user's browser had sent. This was a security hole, not clutter.
debug_beacons_removed.operator_cleanup: The option row apollo_agent_debug_c3f157 may still exist on the live database, and stray debug-c3f157.log files may exist in wp-content/ and uploads/. Delete them.

privilege_gaps_closed.hostel_and_featured: APOLLO_ADVERTS_ADMIN_ONLY_META claims enforcement 'at the write boundary, not just hidden in the UI'. That was true for REST (auth_callback branches to manage_options) and FALSE for the metabox: apollo-adverts Plugin::save_meta_box() guarded only on nonce + edit_post, then wrote _classified_hostel, _classified_hostel_url and _classified_featured. Anyone who could edit a classified could flip the switch that bypasses the marketplace auth gate, or promote their own advert. Both render and save are now behind manage_options; a non-admin sees the hostel status as read-only text. _classified_hostel_id gained its first admin input at the same time.
privilege_gaps_closed.per_field_cap: Panel now supports 'cap' => 'manage_options' per field, honoured on BOTH render and save. This is the mechanism that makes an editorial switch declarable instead of hand-guarded in a bespoke metabox — which is how the gap above survived.

$cpt_plan_phase0_and_phase2_executed_202.data_loss_fixed: apollo-events Admin/Metabox.php wrote _event_dj_ids UNCONDITIONALLY, with an else-branch setting it to an empty array. Any save that did not carry _event_dj_ids_json — a quick edit, a bulk action, a programmatic wp_update_post() — blanked the event's line-up. Every other key in that method is written only when its field is present; this one was the exception, and the exception was silent data loss. Now inside its isset guard.
$cpt_plan_phase0_and_phase2_executed_202.sound_regression_closed: config/taxonomies.php $sound_cpts gained 'track'. The track CPT registered earlier the same day passed taxonomies=>[sound] on apollo-djs' owner registration, which never runs (core wins the init:5 race and never forwards `taxonomies`). Until this fix /track posts had no genre at all.

dead_code_retired.apollo-loc/src/Registry.php: Tombstoned. Held a dead duplicate of the CPT registration, both taxonomy registrations AND a full metabox. Never instantiated. Its args DISAGREED with the live registrar (has_archive 'local' vs 'locais') and its docblock claimed rewrite/archive 'gps' and rest_base 'locals' — three values absent from its own body. Wiring it up by accident would have changed the venue archive URL.
dead_code_retired.apollo-loc/src/Admin/Metabox.php: Tombstoned. Monolith duplicating the four live cells, using THE SAME box ids and THE SAME nonce pair — had anything constructed it, two writers would have raced on every _local_* key.
dead_code_retired.note: Files kept as documented tombstones rather than deleted so the reasoning survives in the tree; nothing loads either.

panel_system_hardened.validate_schema: New, runs at boot(), WP_DEBUG-gated and non-fatal (a validator that threw would be a worse outage than the bugs it reports, in a folder that deploys on save). Checks: every field has key and type; type is in KNOWN_TYPES; repeater has opts.cols; repeater_card sub-fields use `name`; select opts are a flat map and not wrapped in 'choices'; taxonomy has opts.taxonomy. Verified against all four real defects — catches every one, silent on the corrected forms.
panel_system_hardened.sanitize_callback: Was honoured for exactly ONE type (repeater_card). A sanitize_callback on a text, select or repeater field was accepted, ignored, and read like protection that was not there. Now applied through apply_field_callback() for every scalar type.
panel_system_hardened.select_enum: A select is a closed set and the saver never enforced it — any value could be posted into an enum field. Now validated against the field's own opts, falling back to the first declared option.

No PHP binary in this environment, so php -l is unrun and the wp-admin visual pass belongs to the operator.

the_fourth_wire.api: apollo_panel_register( $cpt, $schema, $replace = false ) · apollo_panel_registry() · apollo_panel_boot_registered() · class DeclarativePanel extends Panel
the_fourth_wire.what_changed: An admin editing surface is now declared with a plain array. Before this it required subclassing Panel, which meant a class file, an instantiation and a require inside apollo-lux-panels — a coupling that is exactly why only 3 of 17 CPTs ever got a real edit screen.
the_fourth_wire.why_a_registry_and_not_a_filter: A filter is write-only; you can add to it but nothing can ask it what it holds. A registry can be READ, which is what lets the schema validator sweep every panel at once, lets a harness assert coverage per CPT, and will let Phase 4 derive show_in_rest from the panel schema instead of a second declaration in MetaRegistry.
safety_properties: DORMANT-SAFE — apollo_panel_boot_registered() skips any panel whose post type is not registered, so a plugin may declare its panel before (or without) its CPT rather than producing an orphan metabox on no screen.

NEVER CLOBBERS — a second registration for a live post type is refused unless $replace is explicit. This is the guard that makes the `event` defect (two live metabox systems, the legacy one winning on DOM order) non-reproducible through this contract.
VALIDATED — every declarative panel runs Panel::validate_schema() at boot, so a malformed field is caught at registration rather than by a fatal on an edit screen.
REGISTERS NOTHING — no CPT, taxonomy, meta key or table.
the_fourth_wire.load_order: registry.php must be required AFTER Panel.php, which DeclarativePanel extends. Asserted by harness E29.

first_two_consumers.track: apollo-djs/includes/panel-track.php — 13 fields across 2 tabs. Closes the gap where `track` shipped with 12 registered meta keys and ZERO inputs; a DJ could create a Faixa with a title and nothing else. Field shape mirrors _dj_tracks v2 deliberately, so apollo_dj_get_tracks() can merge CPT rows with legacy meta rows during migration without a translation layer. `sound` is a taxonomy field, not a string — the genre vocabulary already exists and registering a second would fork it.
first_two_consumers.hostel: apollo-adverts/includes/panel-hostel.php — 5 fields. Closes the same gap for hostel. Kept deliberately THIN: no address, coordinates or gallery, because `local` already registers all three and a hostel relates to one through _hostel_loc_id. Duplicating those keys is the divergence apollo-adverts.json already flags at $accommodation_meta_and_depoimentos_2026_07_28.
first_two_consumers.proof_of_the_contract: Neither required an edit to apollo-lux-panels. Both were validated by Panel::validate_schema() in the sandbox before shipping — its first real use — and both came back clean, with coverage of 12/14 track keys and 5/5 hostel keys. The two excluded track keys (_track_genre_legacy, _track_migrated_from) are migration-only and must NOT be hand-editable.

ecosystem_health.what_it_reports: Per CPT: registered vs declared-in-config, meta key count, whether a panel exists, input count, meta keys with no input anywhere, panel fields with no registered meta key, panels failing schema validation, and whether the surface and card contracts are live or dormant.
ecosystem_health.what_it_deliberately_does_not_do: It writes nothing — no meta, no options, no posts, no files. Harness E29 asserts that mechanically by failing if update_post_meta/update_option/wp_insert_post/file_put_contents/unlink/rename appear in the file at all.
ecosystem_health.why_report_and_not_repair: The brief asked for code that fixes its own channels and applies self-learning. In THIS environment that would be actively harmful: the folder deploys on save with no staging tier, there is no PHP binary and no test suite to verify a self-applied fix, and three plugins sit in the HIGH security-risk band. The stronger argument is the 2026-08-17 audit itself — the REST PII leak, the /_agent_debug hole, two fatal edit screens, a decorative admin panel, and _event_dj_ids blanking line-ups were ALL invisible while the system kept running. A layer that healed around them would have hidden them longer. Self-VALIDATING, not self-modifying; fail-closed, not fail-quiet. Adaptive behaviour is confined to presentation, where a wrong guess is cosmetic: apollo_card_render() falling back to the first declared variant, hydrateScripts() waking whatever runtime a fragment ships.
ecosystem_health.exemptions: _track_genre_legacy, _track_migrated_from and _event_is_gone are excluded from the no-input check — they are written by a migration script or by cron, and giving them a hand-editable field would be the bug rather than the fix.

problem_measured.dj: 35 admin panel fields vs 14 frontend form fields — 21 missing, including EVERY social and platform link (_dj_instagram, _dj_facebook, _dj_twitter, _dj_tiktok, _dj_youtube, _dj_soundcloud, _dj_spotify, _dj_bandcamp, _dj_beatport, _dj_mixcloud, _dj_resident_advisor, _dj_website).
problem_measured.the_sharp_edge: The approved dj single-page mockup RENDERS _dj_soundcloud, _dj_spotify and _dj_bandcamp. A DJ editing their own page could not fill three fields their own page displays — only an administrator could, in wp-admin.
problem_measured.bidirectional: They diverged BOTH ways: the frontend owns _local_image_1..5 and both loc taxonomies, which the admin panel lacks. Neither surface was a superset of the other.

$panel_to_frontend_derivation_2026_08_17.why_derivation_not_addition: Hand-writing the missing 21 would produce two files of 35 that must then stay in sync forever — the same two-declarations defect at a larger size. One schema with two renderers cannot drift from itself. Same reasoning as the surface, card and panel contracts.

design.additive_never_destructive: Runs at priority 20 on apollo_frontend_fields_{cpt}, AFTER each plugin's own definitions at priority 10. A hand-written field ALWAYS wins; derivation only fills gaps. Hand-written definitions carry human-tuned placeholders, descriptions and section assignments, and a generated field must never overwrite considered copy. The old files keep working and can be retired one at a time once proven equivalent.
design.type_map_lives_once: apollo_panel_type_to_frontend(). The two systems grew separate vocabularies — panel says toggle/media_single/wysiwyg, editor says checkbox/image/textarea. Every plugin previously bridged them by hand, which is how _dj_verified ended up a toggle in admin and a checkbox on the front end.
design.unrenderable_types_are_SKIPPED_not_downg: repeater, repeater_card, media_gallery, hours, lineup and user_multiselect map to '' and are omitted. FrontendEditor::sanitize_field() returns a string with no array branch, so a repeater submitted through the frontend would be FLATTENED and its stored rows destroyed. A repeater rendered as a text input is a data-loss bug wearing a field's clothing. That same limitation is why `track` became a CPT rather than staying a repeater.
design.capability_and_context_honoured: A field with 'cap' is excluded for users lacking it, so staff-only fields never reach a self-service form. 'contexts' => ['admin'] excludes without needing a capability, for things that are simply not the author's business.

$webp_layer_2026_08_31.what: apollo-core became the carrier for the WebP MU-plugin.
$webp_layer_2026_08_31.why_here: Only wp-content/plugins/ is mirrored to the host, so an MU-plugin cannot be deployed directly. apollo-core already solved this for the .htaccess lock; webp-install.php mirrors apollo_core_htaccess_install_mu_plugin() rather than inventing a second mechanism.
$webp_layer_2026_08_31.no_new_surface: No CPT, no meta key, no option, no REST route, no admin page. One require_once added beside includes/htaccess-lock.php.
